module_role: M-507 chilled-water P&ID context. This sheet contains the exact BAS I/O matrix in the companion module and a schematic/PRV design note; it does not print a written chilled-water sequence of operations.

network_architecture.limitation: M-507 identifies selected I/O as pulled from the chiller controller, but does not name a BAS protocol, controller model, transport, or addressing method. The separate M-509 written sequence is the source for BACNET requirements.

written_sequence_of_operations.review_basis: Full-page visual review and dual-engine text capture show a chilled-water P&ID, PRV note, and BAS I/O point list rather than a written sequence-of-operations block. M-509, not this sheet, supplies the written chilled-water sequence.

p_and_id_context.title: CHILLED WATER SYSTEM P&ID
p_and_id_context.system_scope: The P&ID labels CH-1, CHP-1, CHP-2, and CI-1. These are schematic labels only; the supplied excerpt has no plan/equipment schedule basis for converting them to installation quantities.
p_and_id_context.bypass_valve: 2-WAY CHILLED WATER BYPASS VALVE LOCATED AT END OF LOOP
p_and_id_context.controller_ownership_note: * INDICATES POINT PULLED FROM CHILLER CONTROLLER
p_and_id_context.makeup_water_note: The PRV note requires 4 to 5 PSI at the highest pipe elevation, same-elevation tie-in of makeup water with the expansion tank and air separator, contractor field verification of tie-in elevation, and a printed PRV-setpoint formula.
p_and_id_context.field_connection_note: The potable-water connection is field-verified and references Plumbing Sheet PP-302; it is not an asserted installed connection location.

sensor_and_zone_ledger.limitation: M-507 is a schematic and point matrix, without plans or a sensor schedule. Point-level indications remain in points_m507_chw_template.json and are not converted to physical sensor counts or zone assignments.
